name: Ichrak Mosref
bio: Ichrak Mosref holds a BEng in Industrial Electronics from the National School of Engineers in Sousse, Tunisia, awarded in 2025. During her graduation project, she joined an R&D engineering team, where she worked as an Embedded Linux Developer. Ichrak joined the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence in August 2026 as a Research Engineer I.
shortBio: Research engineer working on embedded Linux and industrial electronics.
